# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 92 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 50 | Coptic

---

## Saying 92

Jesus said: "Keep searching and you will find. But what you once asked me about, and which I didn't answer then — now I want to tell you, and you're not even asking."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Keep searching" — the continuous, persistent quality of seeking
- "Which I didn't answer then" — the withholding framed as non-answering
- "Not even asking" — the frustration of the missed opportunity is heightened
